product_one_liner.value: Gushwork provides SMBs with AI marketing agents that improve discovery across AI search, Google, and paid channels and turn buyer interest into qualified inbound leads.
product_one_liner.notes: The official homepage says its AI agents help SMBs get discovered across AI search, Google, and paid channels and turn that interest into marketing-qualified leads.

pricing_page.notes: Gushwork has a public pricing page that states a monthly starting price and describes the plan.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company pricing page’s customer testimonials and case outcomes identify Midwest Power Products, Source Equipment, and Fraxtional as customers. | named_customers.0: The customer testimonial identifies Midwest Power Products by name. | named_customers.1: The customer testimonial identifies Source Equipment by name. | named_customers.2: The customer testimonial identifies Fraxtional by name.

employee_band.notes: A current November 2026 profile estimates 232 employees, mapping to 201-500. A Gushwork job posting instead describes a team of about 90, so headcount estimates conflict; the newer estimate supports this band, with medium confidence.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The recent location profile explicitly identifies Lewes as the headquarters city; Gushwork’s organization data independently lists its U.S. address in Lewes, Delaware. The company also has a Bengaluru office, so the HQ city is not being inferred from that office. | hq_country: A recent company-location profile labels Lewes, Delaware, United States as headquarters and Bengaluru as an office; TechCrunch independently distinguishes Delaware headquarters from the Bengaluru office. The country is the United States.

founded_year.notes: Lightspeed’s Gushwork portfolio profile explicitly gives 2023 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog index describes its content as practical SEO, AI-search, and lead-generation guides and lists marketing-focused posts; it is not an engineering/technical blog with two build-focused articles.

public_docs.notes: The inspected official homepage and its ending/footer rendering provide product and demo navigation but no public documentation or help-center link; no public documentation portal was located. Under the requested rule, this supports false.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A current open-roles inventory lists the role titles and states that only two openings are engineering roles; the listed engineering titles are Forward Deployed Engineer and Implementation Engineer, not any of the AI/ML/data-science title categories specified. This supports false, with medium confidence because the inventory is an independent job-board source.

model_provider.value: Anthropic and OpenAI, alongside some in-house models.
model_provider.notes: A published interview quotes Gushwork’s CEO saying it uses Anthropic heavily and OpenAI as well, with a significant portion of models built in-house.

compliance_certs.notes: Gushwork has a legal/privacy page describing security measures, but this security section names no listed certification. The policy mentions GDPR as a legal framework elsewhere, not as a certification or a claim of certification, so the supported list is empty.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The announcement identifies the round as seed. | funding_date: The latest funding announcement is dated February 26, 2026, which yields the requested YYYY-MM date 2026-02. | funding_amount_usd: Gushwork’s dated announcement says it raised $9 million in a seed round on February 26, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The $9 million seed round was announced February 26, 2026, within the 18-month period preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Lever posting is titled Sales Development Representative and says Gushwork is hiring for an outbound sales team, so it meets the requested SDR/BDR/AE condition.

launched_6mo.notes: The company’s announcements index lists a new product item dated July 21, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026; it also lists the June 2 AI Editor launch.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Gushwork account-executive job posting names Zoho, HubSpot, and Salesforce as CRM proficiency examples; these are the visible CRM stack signals in the posting. | crm_stack_signal.0: Zoho is named in the job posting’s CRM proficiency examples. | crm_stack_signal.1: HubSpot is named in the job posting’s CRM proficiency examples. | crm_stack_signal.2: Salesforce is named in the job posting’s CRM proficiency examples.
